v0.3.0.description:
❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥 WOOO!! This is my first-ever published release on GitHub!! ✨✨✨

⚠️ **WARNING:** This is a **beta release.** The game is feature-complete, but it hasn't been tested by anybody other than me. Please report any bugs you find!

😣 **Known Issues:** There is a known visual glitch when the `!release` command is used: if item animations are turned on, all chests (even the already empty ones) will be shown sending out their items, and multiple animations of the same item might be overlaid on one another, causing the images to be cropped.

---

➡️ You can find the web client online at https://not-aoyama.github.io/ChestsNKeys-Web/. Or, you can download the ZIP file and play offline!
v0.3.0.title: v0.3.0 - Beta Testing: First Public Release!
